headline: Allstate's website and app have had problems since Nov 23; Allstate has not given a cause, and nothing public points to a cyberattack.
summary: New incident page. Read TechCrunch (Nov 25) and Newsweek (undated, Nov 25 by its text), and Allstate's home page and corporate newsroom. Main answer Not established and answer_group unclear: no cause given, and only Newsweek's assessment that there is no public evidence of an attack. incident_type outage. No service state: the outage is reported, but Allstate's home page showed no outage notice at our read and no source says whether sign-in and the app work again, so the state is not guessed. The officials' comment on upgrades covers recent outages in general, not Allstate by name. Open: cause, whether it is back, whether data was affected. Privacy check done: no people named; the claims phone number in Newsweek is left out.
author: Research agent
